name: Surfacing Modal
description: A dialog that surfaces from below, tipped back and coming into focus, opened by a button whose label slides away for an icon.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Open state (controlled). Use defaultOpen when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog opens or closes.

props.name: children
props.description: The label. On hover or keyboard focus it slides out to the right.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon that slides in from the left in its place.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Button.

props.name: children
props.description: SurfacingModalContent and SurfacingModalFooter. A function receives close(); any button with slot="close" also closes.

props.name: size
props.description: Width of 400, 520 or 720 pixels, or the whole window less 24 pixels all round.

props.name: isDismissable
props.description: Close when the scrim is clicked. Escape always closes.

props.name: closeButton
props.description: Shows a close button in the top right corner.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Padded, stacks its children with 20 pixels between them and scrolls when tall. Put a ModalTitle inside to name the dialog.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Actions aligned to the end; put the main action last.
